attempts.summary: Deployed a fresh 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, RHEL9, mariadb-server-galera 10.5.29) since no cluster pre-existed. Fixed an !includedir ordering bug (galera.cnf loaded after custom config and reset wsrep_on=0) by renaming the custom file to sort last. Bootstrapped node1, joined node2/node3, created appdb.orders with 3 committed rows plus an appuser account. Took the entire cluster down cleanly (node3, node2, node1 order) for the maintenance window, confirmed node1 held the highest seqno with safe_to_bootstrap=1, then brought it back up (bootstrap node1, join node2/node3) with all 3 original rows plus a post-restart write verified present on all three nodes. Finally executed the mandatory one-at-a-time node-restart protocol (node3, node2, node1) using native `reboot`, proving changed boot_id on each node and confirming each rejoined the cluster as Synced/Primary with full data intact before proceeding to the next node.
